- Outstanding: liability cap language — our standard is limited to fees paid in the last 12 months. We can add a carveout for gross negligence; if Olive's Legal needs different language, lets mark it as an escalation to CFO legal counsel.

1) Send DocuSign on Tue 17 Feb by 10:00 PT to the identified signers (Analytics Director, Procurement, CFO).
2) Allow a 72-hour signer window (auto-reminder at 24/48 hrs).
3) If signed by Fri 20 Feb, target commencement Mon 23 Feb (onboarding prep over the weekend).

If Procurement indicates they need PO lead time, the start date may need to move 7–10 days. Please confirm PO timing.
